correctness.rationale: Finite-abelian character orthogonality on C=ker(sum:A^n->A) makes R*R a disjoint union of all-ones Gram blocks indexed by diagonal-character cosets. Orbit block length equals number of character symbols with multiplicity >=s=n-r. The block eigenvalue is t, hence j=1..min(q,floor(n/s)); multinomial exponential-generating function counts their multiplicities after dividing by q. Distance n between distinct diagonal-alias words gives injectivity iff 2r<n. Minimum maximal q-symbol occupancy ceil(n/q) gives surjectivity iff r>=n-ceil(n/q). Both yield binary odd middle unitarity; balanced two-symbol occupancy yields (q-1)/2 binom(n,n/2) kernel dimension at first alias. Independent finite direct enumerations for q=2..5, n=2..6 and all radii corroborate the unlimited character argument.
